title: lane r4 SE: inseparability discriminator under-inclusive; executed-pin rule needed
description: Lane round 4. Lens: SE (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: keying on unresolved identifiers misses signature/trait/type/macro diagnostics (E0308, E0277, E0061, E0599) — a pin failing to build at baseline via arity or trait mismatch is admitted as valid red; the common Result/Option fix shape fabricates a demonstration. Citations verified: contract:64, :66. Proposed: resolved-candidate (replace the discriminator: a valid red is a run-time failure of an EXECUTED pin; a pin that fails to build or be collected at baseline, whatever the diagnostic kind, is not a demonstration; compile-red only when the finding declares the defect to be that the code under test fails to compile).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: executed-pin rule — a valid red is a run-time failure of a built, collected, executed pin; failure to build or collect at the baseline is no demonstration whatever the diagnostic kind (identifiers, signature/arity, trait bounds, macros); compile-red only when the finding declares a compile defect of the code under test. Revision: gate bullet.
